_doc: POLICY CONFIG — edit this file (not engine code) to change cost/tax line structure. Each line is a self-describing object. 'type' is editable: pct_of_freight | pct_of_cargo_value | pct_of_services | pct_of_LC | pct_of_sell | fixed | derived. For percentage types set 'rate' (inline) or 'rateFrom' (path into the trade). For 'fixed' set 'amount' or 'amountFrom'. 'derived' lines name a structural 'derivation' (per_mt | tc_hire | demurrage | credit_interest | wc_interest | ngn_per_mt | ngn_fixed | pct_of_depot_cargo_value). A trade may override any field per line via trade.costLineOverrides[id]. The engine reads 'type' and applies the matching base — no rate/percentage/%-vs-fixed assumption lives in calculation code.

lines.label: NIMASA gross freight levy 3%
lines.legalRef: NIMASA gross freight levy (non-NTA maritime levy)

lines.label: WHT on freight 5%
lines.legalRef: TAA 2025 s.51 (Deduction at source); rate per Deduction-of-Tax-at-Source Regs — UNVERIFIED

lines.label: VAT on freight 7.5% (recoverable)
lines.legalRef: Nigeria Tax Act 2025 s.147; recoverable input VAT s.155(4)

lines.label: VAT on services 7.5% (recoverable)
lines.legalRef: Nigeria Tax Act 2025 s.147; recoverable s.155(4); INFERRED base composition

lines.label: NMDPRA export permit fee
lines.activeStatus: USD 1,000 per application (Midstream & Downstream Petroleum Fees Regs 2024, Table 6)
lines.legalRef: Midstream & Downstream Petroleum Fees Regulations 2024 — Export Permit USD 1,000/application; quarterly via IMPEX

lines.label: NESS levy (oil) 0.12%
lines.activeStatus: 0.12% of FOB (oil & gas exports; CBN FX Manual 4th ed. June 2026)
lines.legalRef: Nigerian Export Supervision Scheme — 0.12% of FOB for oil/gas exports (CBN), collected by designated bank at NXP

lines.label: Wholesale supply licence charge ₦1/L (export evacuation)
lines.activeStatus: NGN 1 per litre or barrel equivalent — wholesale liquids licence, export evacuation (Fees Regs 2024 First Schedule)
lines.legalRef: Midstream & Downstream Petroleum Fees Regulations 2024, First Schedule item 2: NGN 1/litre or barrel equivalent for export evacuation

lines.label: DRC OCC inspection 2% FOB
lines.activeStatus: 2% of FOB — Office Congolais de Contrôle certification of imports into DRC
lines.legalRef: DRC: Arrêté interministériel 068/2006 — products entering DRC certified by OCC (quantité + qualité); OCC tariff ~2% FOB, BIVAC pre-shipment ≥ USD 2,500

lines.label: DRC import duty + VAT (buyer's account unless CFR)
lines.activeStatus: CEMAC CET 5-20% + VAT 16% — normally buyer's cost on FOB terms; include only if seller bears them (CFR/DAP)
lines.legalRef: DRC applies CEMAC Common External Tariff (5–20%) + 16% import VAT; DGDA collection; GUICE platform clearance
